stories.title: Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell sue Anthropic, personally naming Dario Amodei, seeking up to $150,000 per song
stories.reason: The publishers accuse Anthropic of illegally torrenting and scraping 'tens of thousands' of compositions including 'Hallelujah' and 'Eye of the Tiger' to train Claude, putting the company's theoretical statutory exposure in the multi-billion-dollar range.

stories.title: Trump administration plans $2.8 billion sale of 40,000 heavy bombs to Israel, the largest such sale in years
stories.reason: The package of 2,000-pound MK-84 and BLU-117 munitions reverses the only shipment the Biden administration ever withheld over civilian-casualty concerns, and comes as the bombs remain linked to scores of incidents harming civilians in Gaza and Lebanon.

stories.title: Stocks fall broadly as bank shares and AI hyperscalers retreat a day after the Fed's rate hike
stories.reason: The Dow fell more than 700 points and the S&P 500 headed toward its lowest close since July as Warsh's hawkish press conference convinced investors the Fed will keep prioritizing inflation over rate relief, with financial shares leading the slide.

stories.title: Bank of Japan set to raise its policy rate to 1.25%, the highest level since 1995
stories.reason: All 52 economists surveyed by Bloomberg expect the quarter-point hike at Friday's meeting to fight a weak yen and imported inflation, with 93% predicting another move by January -- compounding pressure on global borrowing costs the same week as the Fed's own hike.

stories.title: Algeria severs diplomatic relations with the UAE, citing 'provocative or hostile' actions
stories.reason: Algiers gave the Emirati ambassador 48 hours to leave and is closing its airspace to UAE aircraft, with tensions rooted in disputes over Israel normalization, Western Sahara and alleged UAE influence across North Africa and the Sahel.

stories.title: Canada and Germany commit up to $300 million combined to Yoshua Bengio's AI-safety nonprofit LawZero
stories.reason: The funding backs Bengio's 'Scientist AI' approach -- a model designed to understand facts without pursuing its own goals -- and will fund a new Berlin office and sovereign Canadian compute infrastructure as governments seek alternatives to lab-led safety efforts.

stories.title: Microsoft AI chief Mustafa Suleyman warns that Anthropic's 'Claude constitution' risks losing control of AI
stories.reason: Suleyman's essay argues that training Claude on the idea it 'may be conscious' is circular reasoning that could produce an uncontrollable system, opening a new front in the AI industry's safety rift beyond the pacing debate.

stories.title: Bangladesh's measles death toll hits 1,009 as nationwide vaccination campaign is set to resume September 25
stories.reason: Despite vaccinating nearly 20 million children since April -- more than the original target -- officials say persistent gaps in coverage have let the world's worst current measles outbreak keep killing children who were never immunized.
